description: Entitlement-precedence contract vectors encoding the N3 invariants of AgentLens/Services/MacCloudEntitlementStore.swift (publishMembershipEntitlements + preferred(over:) + per-tier merge + StoreKit UID-binding fail-closed). Consumed initially only by scripts/ci/check-budget-enforcement-fixture.mjs structural checks; a future pure Core function (EntitlementArbitration.effectiveTier(cloud:storeKit:now:), Wave-5 PR-C) will execute them. cloud[].key maps to the entitlement doc listeners: hostedQuota=cloud tier, hostedComputerUse=pro tier, proMax=pro tier, ultra=ultra tier. A cloud doc is active only when active==true AND (expiry is null OR expiry > now). When any cloud doc yields an active tier, the cloud plane replaces StoreKit entirely; StoreKit is only a fallback when the cloud plane is empty. StoreKit entries count only when uidBound==true, revoked==false, and not expired. Per-tier merge keeps the entitlement with the later expiry; a dated expiry is preferred over an undated one. Ultra implies Pro implies Cloud.

vectors.description: an active cloud doc replaces the StoreKit plane entirely, even when StoreKit holds a higher tier
a lapsed cloud doc (active flag still true but expiry in the past) is invisible and must not suppress a valid StoreKit entitlement
a StoreKit transaction without a server-minted appAccountToken bound to the signed-in UID fails closed to free
a revoked StoreKit transaction confers nothing
an expired StoreKit transaction confers nothing
with no cloud docs, a bound, unrevoked, unexpired StoreKit transaction confers its catalog tier
two active cloud docs merge per tier keeping the later expiry: hostedQuota (Sep) + proMax (Oct) yields cloud expiring Oct via the pro doc's implied cloud entitlement
an active ultra doc populates the ultra, pro, and cloud tiers with the same entitlement
when two active entitlements merge into the same tier, a dated expiry is preferred over an undated one (preferred(over:) contract)
